## Model Answer: Automation-as-a-Service

### Automation-as-a-Service — Recurring Revenue Tiers

| Tier | Price | Includes | SLA |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Basic** | $297/mo | Up to 3 active workflows, email support, monthly report | Best-effort |
| **Professional** | $697/mo | Up to 10 active workflows, priority support, weekly report | 99% uptime, <4hr response |
| **Enterprise** | Custom (from $1,500/mo) | Unlimited workflows, dedicated support, custom SLA | Negotiated |

**SLA management:** performance monitored weekly (success rate, error count); breach triggers immediate client notification, a root-cause note within 24 hours, and a pro-rated credit per contract terms.

**Billing:** monthly recurring, auto-invoiced on the 1st, net-0 (charged automatically) for Professional/Enterprise; Basic is manually invoiced net-7.

**Onboarding:** discovery call -> workflow audit of the client's current manual processes -> migration of first 1-3 workflows -> 30-day check-in call to review performance and consider tier upgrade.

**Revenue analytics tracked monthly:** MRR by tier, churn rate, upgrade rate Basic->Professional, average workflows-per-client.
